description: This file defines an abstract class for Twig extensions, providing default method implementations for various extension features such as token parsers, node visitors, filters, tests, functions, and operators.

classes.name: Twig\Extension\AbstractExtension
classes.description: An abstract class that implements common methods for Twig extensions, serving as a base class for extension implementations.

methods.name: getTokenParsers
methods.description: Returns an empty array indicating no token parsers by default.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns an empty array indicating no node visitors by default.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns an empty array indicating no filters by default.

methods.name: getTests
methods.description: Returns an empty array indicating no tests by default.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns an empty array indicating no functions by default.

methods.name: getOperators
methods.description: Returns an array with two empty arrays, indicating no operators by default.
